notes:
Read the entire 104849-character markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A, covering all 18 PDF pages. Source of record is arXiv:2403.11164v1, dated 17 March 2024. Checked the supplement statement and Appendix A against text extracted with pymupdf. No data-sharing, code-release, preregistration, embargo, or data-on-request statement was found. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty.

The paper's only explicit availability statement points to a full study protocol in supplementary material, without a URL. The PDF's external link annotations contain the publication DOI, commercial tool homepages and cited publications, but no study-data or code repository link. Tool homepages and references to other papers were not treated as data-deposit links. The private Midjourney gallery described in Section 3.4 is a data-collection location, not an offered public deposit. Appendix A, Table A.1 (p. 18), reports aggregate NASA-TLX means and standard errors, not participant records.

Publisher checks: GET https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3613904.3642919 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' bot check. GET https://doi.org/10.1145/3613904.3642919 also ended in HTTP 403 with a bot check. No attempt was made to pass those checks. Thus the publisher's supplementary file inventory, access requirements, contents and license remain unconfirmed; a bot check was not classified as an account requirement, dead link or evidence of unavailable data. There is no confirmed supplementary-deposit URL to put in deposits.

The DataCite result https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11164 returned HTTP 200. Its submission history lists v1 only. No specific dataset, analysis-code or ancillary-file link appears on its landing page. The generic 'Code, Data, Media' integrations are not evidence of a deposited dataset. HEAD https://arxiv.org/src/2403.11164 returned HTTP 200 and Content-Length 37882419 for arXiv-2403.11164v1.tar.gz; the archive was not downloaded or inspected because it exceeds the 20 MB limit. The article/preprint alone was not counted as a data deposit.

The Figshare search hit is a third-party literature-review archive, not the authors' S1 data deposit. Its public API file inventory and its 52154-byte spreadsheet were checked. The spreadsheet contains a single study-description row for c127 (Table B1, Excel row 51) among 64 study rows. Columns are: no.; Author(s), Year; Study / Source; Journal/ Conference; Domain / Creative Context; AI Technology / System; Creative Task / Design Stage; Participants / Sample; Study Design / Method; Creativity Conceptualisation; Assessment Focus; Metrics / Evidence; Key Findings; Human-centred Coding Notes; DOI / Source URL. A second sheet, Coding Notes, contains four guidance rows plus a header. There are no participant records or numeric creativity outcome scores for c127. This review archive and the unrelated Zenodo citing paper are documented in searches and excluded from deposits.

No usable public participant-level or output-level data were confirmed for S1. Consequently no missing arm means, participant-level SDs/SEs, GenAI-minus-Image-Search effects, model-specific analyzed counts, sketch/rater row structure, fluency-count correction, variety normalization, or participant-linked diversity measures can be computed from the located resources. This leaves final.open_items concerning open_questions[2], [4], [5] and [6] unresolved; the protocol-related item [3] also remains unresolved.

none_found means no public study-data deposit was identified in these checks; it does not establish that no deposit exists.
